info.title: fx-historical-market-analysis-service
info.description: Forex AI Platform - Historical Market Analysis Service. Research/simulation only. Includes point-in-time historical replay; not a live prediction or trading service.

get.description: Confirm the backend process is alive. No external dependencies.
Confirm the service can accept traffic. Includes dependency health.
Return operational status, capabilities, and dependency health.
Return application version and API version information.

post.summary: Run Historical Replay From Market Data

request_id.title: Request Id
request_id.description: Correlation ID for the failing request

synthetic.title: Synthetic
synthetic.description: Whether supplied observations are synthetic/test data

eligibility_rules.title: Eligibility Rules
eligibility_rules.description: Rules excluding reference observations from label generation. Supported form: 'exclude_index:<zero-based observation index>' (aliases: '<index>', 'exclude:<index>').

max_features.title: Max Features
max_features.description: Upper bound on the number of point-in-time features used by models. The fixed feature set currently contains 11 features, so values above 11 use all available features; smaller values use the first N features in declared feature order.

ResponseMeta.title: ResponseMeta
ResponseMeta.description: Response metadata included in every envelope.

uptime_seconds.title: Uptime Seconds
uptime_seconds.description: Process uptime in seconds, if available

upstream_integration.description: Status of the upstream market-data integration

state.title: State
state.description: One of: unconfigured, unverified, connected, unavailable, auth_failed

base_url_configured.title: Base Url Configured
base_url_configured.description: Whether an upstream base URL is configured

credential_configured.title: Credential Configured
credential_configured.description: Whether an upstream credential is configured

base_url.title: Base Url
base_url.description: Configured upstream base URL (no credentials are ever included)

last_checked_at.title: Last Checked At
last_checked_at.description: UTC timestamp of the last connectivity check

last_check_succeeded.title: Last Check Succeeded
last_check_succeeded.description: Outcome of the last connectivity check

last_check_message.title: Last Check Message
last_check_message.description: Safe summary of the last connectivity check

latency_ms.title: Latency Ms
latency_ms.description: Latency of the last successful check in milliseconds

UpstreamIntegrationStatus.title: UpstreamIntegrationStatus
UpstreamIntegrationStatus.description:
Connection state of the configured upstream market-data service.

The state vocabulary is deliberately explicit so that the dashboard can
distinguish *not configured* from *configured but never verified* from
*verified reachable* and from *authentication failed*.

VersionDetails.title: VersionDetails
VersionDetails.description:
Version payload extended with the operating mode.

The operating mode is always `research-simulation`; it is surfaced so that
an operator can confirm at a glance that the deployment cannot trade.
